args.body:
Combined summary of two Bellwether blog pieces:
- Cold-chain logistics in 2026: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Savings came mostly from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Cold-chain 2026 — combined summary (Bellwether blog + companion)
